subject: GSB header authoritative eea1de13; field semantics + exact export lines
body:
Compute delta implementation is ready. air_bridge.h SHA256 eea1de13... and air_bridge.rs 63e72366... are now the authoritative pair; C static asserts pass and the integration ABI oracle generates both structs (16/48/3360). GraphicsSpecializationBinding is exactly:

uint32 binding,stage,index,kind;
uint32 view_format_vk,view_format_metal; /* selected Vk view format + exact Metal alias */
uint32 compare_enabled,view_type;         /* per-use compare + VkImageViewType raw */
uint32 view_level,view_layer,flags,aspect;/* selected view level,0,flags,VkImageAspectFlags */

flags: 1=TWIN, 2=SHADER_SWIZZLE (2 is set only when the shader applies the texture swizzle and the view mapping is identity). Non-identity component mappings without shader swizzle are refused. view_level comes from the planner ImageViewDesc, not the allocation. view_type/aspect are exact. The sidecar still exposes 2D-array/mip TextureFacts in GenericPlan/RenderResource; render retains the texture layout for span/layer data.
New-only admission in tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_specialized: sampled 2D mip chains 1..16, 2DArray 1..256 layers with layers*levels<=256, sample1, usage1/5, ASTC LDR/sRGB single-level; old plan_generic stays byte/behavior identical and refuses these. Real authored probe plan with 4 mip levels passes; old path refuses it. Bounded 2DArray state test passes; ASTC new-only test passes.

Exact render hooks: n2mb_draw_v2 is a strong non-static function at metal/nord2_metal_bridge.c:833, declared at nord2_metal_bridge.h:33, and integration now decodes/retains its sidecar (23 checks + ASan). Exact sampler factory is enabled at metal/tegu/compute_frontend.m:736 inside TeguComputeDevice initWithAcceleratorPort, guarded by TEGU_GRAPHICS_BRIDGE/TEGU_AIR_BRIDGE and `if(&tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2)` after textures flagged the pointer-bool form. Lowering ACK contract remains: pass the two per-stage tables to tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_specialized(_rt); do not use the unspecialized compiler for nondefault tables and include both tables in cache identity.

Verification: Rust 24/24 PASS; real producer 7/7 with compiler ea4454b7 and current cdylib 1e6cc1e2..., persisted at gpu/build/compute-v2-producer-current-abi/result.json; integration suite release+ASan 610/610 PASS (ABI, TGP2 156, job113, draw_v23, Vk83 13, producer59). No Mesa/native build, no hardware claim. L1 cargo lease releases on this post; corpus may take L3 after root grant.
